title: Provider reliability and fixes
highlights: OpenAI-compatible providers that answer 529 or another 5xx "heavy usage" error are now retried automatically instead of failing the turn, and the error no longer blames your network
/usage shows real quota windows for Kimi Code, Cursor, and the Z.ai Coding Plan (thanks @ghoker143)
Pressing Esc while a follow-up prompt is pending stops the current turn and runs the follow-up (thanks @SiavZ)
improvements: Copilot accepts reasoning effort for every model whose catalog advertises it and sends it on both the Responses and Chat Completions APIs
Saved API keys stay in their env files instead of the running process, so editing a key file takes effect without a restart
The client shows the context window the server resolved instead of a placeholder
The jcode log records which binary actually launched, to diagnose stale copies on PATH
Gmail can update, list, and delete drafts
Undo in the composer reverts a whole typing burst at once, including Korean and other IME input (thanks @mg-mg-mg)
Cost estimates for OpenAI-compatible profiles fall back to a matching model from another provider's price catalog (thanks @ogodevonline)
Edit tool rows show their intent, and the expand badge appears in every diff mode
fixes: DeepSeek enabled through --provider auto uses its own default model and 1M context instead of anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 with 200K
In-app updates on Termux patch the glibc ELF interpreter like the installer does, and refuse to switch to a binary that cannot run
Configured /colors roles now apply on 256-color terminals
Images in formats providers reject are no longer stored or sent, and sessions self-heal from the resulting 400 errors
Session saves are drained on SIGTERM, and an interrupted checkpoint can no longer duplicate history
Anthropic history repair: orphaned or late tool results and orphaned native web searches no longer cause request errors
Malformed tool calls are corrected within a bounded number of retries instead of looping
Auto-poke re-arms when new open work appears after the completion gate trips
The crash detector no longer reports a session that closed while idle as interrupted (thanks @SK-DEV-AI)
